_comment: Path->unit->artifact map for path-filtered CI. Change a unit path -> build only that unit; change libs/** -> rebuild all consumers.

units.build: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter document-uploader-ui run build
units._note: Vite/React SPA (Codex design system) served by nginx. Pure browser-direct GraphQL client of the ingestion-subgraph router (presignUpload -> S3 PUT -> classifyUploaded). No AWS, no server.
Sidecar-pair Pod: ingestion-subgraph is built here; wundergraph-router is the pulled Cosmo gateway (no source build).
